The *Maṇithūṇavimānavatthu* ("Mansion with Pillars of Gems", Vv 77) is a canonical verse text preserved within the *Vimānavatthu* of the Khuddaka Nikāya. The text recounts an encounter with a celestial deva who explains his past religious offerings and elucidates the heavenly rewards and fruits resulting from his deeds.
